continuities.name: Golmaal films (standalone collection)
continuities.description: Rohit Shetty's Golmaal comedies. Recurring character names (Gopal, Madhav, Lucky, Laxman) and cast, but each film resets their circumstances; ordered by release, not by an in-universe chronology. Wikipedia never states whether the films share a continuity. The same character names (Gopal, Madhav, Lucky, Laxman) recur, but each plot gives them incompatible backstories, so the films are treated as standalone stories in one release-ordered collection.
continuities.quote: Friends Gopal, Lucky, Madhav and Laxman often dupe gullible people out of their money. … Gopal, who lives with his ever suspecting wife, Ekta … Five orphan men return to the orphanage they grew up in to attend their mentor's funeral. … This table lists the main characters who appear in the Golmaal franchise.
continuities.note: Backstory conflicts, quoted from the plot sections: Golmaal Returns: "He also lives with his sister Esha and Ekta's mute brother, his brother in law Lucky." Golmaal 3: "Pritam ... His three good-for-nothing sons, Madhav ... Laxman ... and Lucky, the innocent mute" and "Geeta ... whose two sons, Laxman, the stammerer, and Gopal". Golmaal Again: "Gopal, Madhav, Laxman 1, Laxman 2, and Lucky live in an orphanage in Ooty". Inferred standalone status: Wikipedia has no explicit statement either way.

continuities.name: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
continuities.description: A spiritual sequel, unrelated to the earlier films' stories. Kartik Aaryan's Ruhaan "Rooh Baba" Randhawa returns from Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2, and Vidya Balan plays "an alternate version of her character". It is a separate continuity because Wikipedia calls it unrelated; the Rooh Baba link is recorded as shares-characters.
continuities.quote: The third part also serves as a spiritual sequel and is not related to the earlier films. … released in 2024 with Kartik Aaryan reprising his role as Rooh Baba from the sequel … A spiritual sequel, ''[[Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3]]'', starring Aaryan … was released on Diwali 2024.
continuities.note: Possibly disputed: Aaryan "reprising his role as Rooh Baba from the sequel" suggests a carried-over character, but "not related to the earlier films" means BB2 and BB3 are kept apart. Rooh Baba's introduction ("Ruhaan, a conman posing as the ghostbuster") reads as a reintroduction.
